Here’s a **complete checklist of programming topics** — beginner to advanced — structured step-by-step. This is universal across languages (C++, Python, Java, etc.), especially useful if you're mastering **problem-solving, competitive programming, or full-stack development**.

---

### ✅ **BEGINNER LEVEL – Foundations**
1. ✅ [ ] **Variables, Data Types, Input/Output**
2. ✅ [ ] **Operators** – Arithmetic, Logical, Relational
3. ✅ [ ] **Conditional Statements** – `if`, `else`, `switch`
4. ✅ [ ] **Loops** – `for`, `while`, `do-while`
5. ✅ [ ] **Basic Patterns** – triangle, pyramid, etc.
6. ✅ [ ] **Functions** – parameters, return values
7. ✅ [ ] **Scope and Lifetime of Variables**
8. ✅ [ ] **Recursion (Intro level)** – factorial, Fibonacci

---

### 🧩 **INTERMEDIATE LEVEL – Logic Building**
9. ✅ [ ] **Arrays (1D and 2D)**
10. ✅ [ ] **Strings and String Manipulation**
11. ✅ [ ] **Pointers/References** *(C/C++ specific)*
12. ✅ [ ] **Structures and Enums**
13. ✅ [ ] **Math & Number Theory**
   - GCD, LCM
   - Prime Numbers
   - Sieve of Eratosthenes
   - Power, Modulo, Factorials
14. ✅ [ ] **Searching Algorithms**
   - Linear Search
   - Binary Search
15. ✅ [ ] **Sorting Algorithms**
   - Bubble, Selection, Insertion
   - Merge Sort, Quick Sort
   - Counting/Heap Sort (Advanced prep)
16. ✅ [ ] **Recursion (Deep)** – Backtracking, Combinations
17. ✅ [ ] **Bit Manipulation** – AND, OR, XOR, left/right shift

---

### 🧠 **ADVANCED LEVEL – Data Structures & Algorithms**
18. ✅ [ ] **Stacks and Queues**
19. ✅ [ ] **Linked Lists** – singly, doubly, circular
20. ✅ [ ] **Trees**
   - Binary Trees
   - Binary Search Trees (BST)
   - Tree Traversals (Inorder, Preorder, Postorder)
21. ✅ [ ] **Heaps and Priority Queues**
22. ✅ [ ] **Graphs**
   - Representations (adjacency list/matrix)
   - BFS, DFS
   - Dijkstra’s Algorithm
   - Union-Find (DSU)
23. ✅ [ ] **Hashing**
   - Hash Maps, Hash Sets
   - Frequency Counters
24. ✅ [ ] **Sliding Window Technique**
25. ✅ [ ] **Two Pointer Technique**
26. ✅ [ ] **Greedy Algorithms**
27. ✅ [ ] **Divide and Conquer**
28. ✅ [ ] **Dynamic Programming (DP)**
   - Memoization vs Tabulation
   - Classic Problems: Fibonacci, Knapsack, LIS, LCS
29. ✅ [ ] **Backtracking**
   - N-Queens
   - Sudoku Solver
   - Maze Solver

---

### 💻 **BONUS – Advanced/Competitive Topics**
30. ✅ [ ] **Segment Trees / Fenwick Trees (BIT)**
31. ✅ [ ] **Tries

Here's a **Beginner to Advanced JavaScript Mastery Checklist**, structured for **full-stack development, problem-solving, and real-world apps**.

---

## ✅ **Beginner – Core JavaScript**
### 🔹 Basics
1. ✅ [ ] Variables (`var`, `let`, `const`)
2. ✅ [ ] Data Types (Number, String, Boolean, Undefined, Null, Symbol, BigInt)
3. ✅ [ ] Type Conversion & Coercion
4. ✅ [ ] Operators (Arithmetic, Logical, Comparison, Bitwise)
5. ✅ [ ] Control Flow (`if`, `else`, `switch`)
6. ✅ [ ] Loops (`for`, `while`, `do...while`, `for...of`, `for...in`)
7. ✅ [ ] Functions – Declaration, Expression, Arrow functions
8. ✅ [ ] Scope – Local, Global, Block
9. ✅ [ ] Hoisting
10. ✅ [ ] Strict Mode (`"use strict"`)

---

## 🧩 **Intermediate – DOM & Logic Building**
### 🔹 Arrays & Strings
11. ✅ [ ] Arrays – methods like `push`, `pop`, `shift`, `unshift`, `splice`, `slice`, `map`, `filter`, `reduce`, `forEach`
12. ✅ [ ] Strings – methods like `split`, `join`, `substring`, `indexOf`, `includes`

### 🔹 Objects & Built-ins
13. ✅ [ ] Objects – keys, values, methods
14. ✅ [ ] Object Destructuring
15. ✅ [ ] JSON – parse and stringify
16. ✅ [ ] Sets and Maps
17. ✅ [ ] Date and Math objects

### 🔹 Functions Deep Dive
18. ✅ [ ] Callback Functions
19. ✅ [ ] Higher-Order Functions
20. ✅ [ ] Closures
21. ✅ [ ] Recursion

### 🔹 Error Handling
22. ✅ [ ] `try...catch`
23. ✅ [ ] `throw` custom errors

---

## 🧠 **Advanced – ES6+ & Modern JS**
### 🔹 ES6+ Features
24. ✅ [ ] `let` vs `const` vs `var`
25. ✅ [ ] Arrow Functions
26. ✅ [ ] Template Literals
27. ✅ [ ] Default Parameters
28. ✅ [ ] Spread and Rest Operators
29. ✅ [ ] Destructuring
30. ✅ [ ] `for...of` vs `for...in`
31. ✅ [ ] Optional Chaining (`?.`)
32. ✅ [ ] Nullish Coalescing (`??`)

### 🔹 Classes & Prototypes
33. ✅ [ ] Prototypes and Prototype Chain
34. ✅ [ ] Constructor Functions
35. ✅ [ ] ES6 Classes
36. ✅ [ ] Inheritance

---

## ⚙️ **Browser & DOM**
### 🔹 DOM Manipulation
37. ✅ [ ] `document.querySelector`, `getElementById`
38. ✅ [ ] Changing HTML/CSS using JS
39. ✅ [ ] Event Listeners (`addEventListener`)
40. ✅ [ ] Event Bubbling & Delegation
41. ✅ [ ] Forms and Validation

### 🔹 BOM (Browser Object Model)
42. ✅ [ ] `window`, `navigator`, `location`, `history`, `localStorage`, `sessionStorage`

---

## 🌐 **Asynchronous JS**
43. ✅ [ ] `setTimeout`, `setInterval`
44. ✅ [ ] Callbacks
45. ✅ [ ] Promises
46. ✅ [ ] `async/await`
47. ✅ [ ] Fetch API
48. ✅ [ ] Error handling in async code

---

## 🧱 **Data Structures & Algorithms in JS**
49. ✅ [ ] Arrays, Linked Lists
50. ✅ [ ] Stacks, Queues
51. ✅ [ ] HashMaps (using Objects/Map)
52. ✅ [ ] Sets
53. ✅ [ ] Recursion
54. ✅ [ ] Sorting & Searching
55. ✅ [ ] Graphs & Trees (basic)

---

## 🔥 **Bonus – Advanced & Real-World**
56. ✅ [ ] Modules – `import`, `export`
57. ✅ [ ] Closures in real-world use
58. ✅ [ ] Debounce & Throttle
59. ✅ [ ] Currying
60. ✅ [ ] Event Loop & Call Stack
61. ✅ [ ] Memory Management & Garbage Collection
62. ✅ [ ] Webpack/Babel (basic)
63. ✅ [ ] JS Design Patterns (Singleton, Module, Observer)
64. ✅ [ ] Security – XSS, CSRF basics

---

## ⚛️ **Optional – Framework Transition**
65. ✅ [ ] DOM vs Virtual DOM
66. ✅ [ ] Basics of React/Vue/Angular (if planning to move to frameworks)
67. ✅ [ ] Node.js basics (for backend with JS)

---
